requirements.statement: The platform does not report the counterparty's release attestation as invalid.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check platform.attestation_not_invalid, from tier T0; a failure gives NO

requirements.statement: The platform reports the counterparty's release as owner-signed.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check platform.owner_signed, from tier T0; recorded, deciding nothing

requirements.statement: The counterparty is not on the operator's deny list.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check operator.not_deny_listed, from tier T0; a failure gives NO

requirements.statement: When the operator keeps an allow list, the counterparty is on it.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check operator.allow_listed, from tier T0; a failure gives NO

requirements.statement: No adjudication this party holds went against the counterparty in the last 180 days.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check own.no_adverse_adjudication (window_days 180), from tier T0; a failure gives NO

requirements.statement: This party's own book holds a settled deal with the counterparty.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check own.settled (min 1), from tier T0; recorded, deciding nothing

requirements.statement: This party holds the counterparty's half of an exchange.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check own.held_halves (min 1), from tier T0; recorded, deciding nothing

requirements.statement: The counterparty's card verifies under the key that presents it.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check card.verified, from tier T1; a failure gives LIMIT; asks for served_summary/1

requirements.statement: The card's latest checkpoint is at most 7 days old.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check card.fresh (max_age_s 604800), from tier T1; a failure gives LIMIT; asks for served_summary/1

requirements.statement: A witness in this pack's trust roots receipted the card's latest checkpoint.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check card.witnessed, from tier T1; a failure gives LIMIT

requirements.statement: The card shows at least 10 claims held, with the claims made as the denominator.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check card.claims_held (min 10), from tier T1; a failure gives LIMIT; asks for served_summary/1

requirements.statement: The card's key declares the controller it is bound to.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check card.controller_declared, from tier T1; a failure gives LIMIT

requirements.statement: No deal with the counterparty is CONFLICTING in this party's own book.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check own.no_conflicting, from tier T1; a failure gives LIMIT

requirements.statement: A selection the counterparty returned to this party's own ask verifies, inclusion proofs included.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check bound.selection_verified, from tier T2; a failure gives LIMIT; asks for selection

requirements.statement: The controller the card declares is in this pack's trust roots.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check card.controller_trusted, from tier T2; a failure gives LIMIT

requirements.statement: The selection shows no dispute with anyone left unanswered in the last 90 days.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check bound.no_unanswered_dispute (window_days 90), from tier T2; a failure gives LIMIT

requirements.statement: Vouches from distinct controllers, not the counterparty's own, are counted.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check vouch.distinct_controllers (min 3), from tier T2; recorded, deciding nothing

requirements.statement: The disclosed history is from the same kind of work as the proposed deal.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check judged, from tier T2; a failure caps the tier at T1

requirements.statement: Collateral posted on this deal covers its amount in the deal's band unit.
requirements.evidence_rule: admission check stake.covers_deal, from tier T2; recorded, deciding nothing
